gaps.title: Build a pnpm workspace
gaps.currentGap: Current pnpm support has bounded native lock and acquisition constraints; this collection has no qualified workspace recipe.
gaps.nextProof: Generate the real native lock, build two related packages and consume their delivered archives without workspace source links.

gaps.title: Build a Yarn Classic workspace
gaps.currentGap: Yarn means Classic here. A current recipe and manager-owned lock must be exercised before publishing instructions.
gaps.nextProof: Build a Classic workspace through the captured manager and consume its packages independently.

gaps.title: Build a uv-managed Python library
gaps.currentGap: The uv adapter exists, but this collection has no independently verified native uv lock and consumer.
gaps.nextProof: Generate uv.lock with the selected native uv, build the wheel and install it in an isolated consumer.

gaps.title: Build a Poetry-managed package
gaps.currentGap: Poetry support does not qualify every lock format or supply a recorded example.
gaps.nextProof: Lock a small package with native Poetry, build through Oyzu and install only its delivered wheel.

gaps.title: Build a legacy Python extension
gaps.currentGap: A legacy setup.py recipe needs a genuine native compiler prerequisite and a compiled-extension consumer proof.
gaps.nextProof: Build and import the delivered extension with the declared native prerequisites, keeping unrelated runtimes unavailable.

gaps.title: Build a Gradle composite
gaps.currentGap: Composite builds and custom native test tasks need a focused recipe using the admitted Gradle contracts.
gaps.nextProof: Build an included library and application, consume the delivered result and verify the custom suite report.

gaps.title: Keep Ant assertions and coverage visible
gaps.currentGap: The packaging baseline does not qualify custom targets or JUnit/coverage collection.
gaps.nextProof: Run a real Ant test suite, inspect native reports, then introduce a failed assertion and require a failed Oyzu result.

gaps.title: Build a locked .NET solution
gaps.currentGap: The current .NET product proof is Linux captured and needs its explicitly provisioned SDK image; broad host support is unproved.
gaps.nextProof: Build a solution with locked restore and project references under SDK 10.0.401, consume its NuGet package and record exact SDK/host facts.

gaps.title: Connect an image and Helm chart
gaps.currentGap: Image output, directory materialization, chart bindings and deployment are separate contracts and still need a collection proof.
gaps.nextProof: Materialize a producer into an image, bind its immutable digest into a chart, and verify both delivered artifacts without deploying.

gaps.title: Package local Helm dependencies
gaps.currentGap: The basic chart has no dependency or umbrella-chart proof.
gaps.nextProof: Package a local library dependency, render the delivered umbrella chart and check the selected values and packaged dependency identity.

gaps.title: Acquire private dependencies without leaking credentials
gaps.currentGap: The source fixtures are design contracts and bounded acquisition proofs; no public collection recipe has qualified disposable authenticated endpoints.
gaps.nextProof: Use scoped test repositories, acquire through supported routes and prove replay and reports contain no credential values.

gaps.title: Inspect reports and failed outputs
gaps.currentGap: The successful baselines do not cover all required failure/report scenarios.
gaps.nextProof: Fail a real native test after a successful build and require rejected acceptance, retained failed reports and no successful replacement artifact.

gaps.title: Publish a native npm package
gaps.currentGap: Native npm publication is agreed destination scope but is outside the current experimental file-artifact provider slice.
gaps.nextProof: After separate provider implementation, publish with native coordinates, retrieve with npm and install in a downstream project.

gaps.title: Publish a native Python distribution
gaps.currentGap: Wheels and sdists wrapped in generic OCI objects do not implement native Python publication.
gaps.nextProof: After separate provider implementation, publish to a disposable Python index and install the retrieved distribution.

gaps.title: Push a native OCI image
gaps.currentGap: Generic OCI file-artifact publication does not establish image manifests, layers, indexes or a downstream image pull.
gaps.nextProof: Qualify native image publication independently, then pull by immutable digest and run the delivered application.

gaps.title: Assess other native package protocols
gaps.currentGap: Maven repositories, NuGet, Cargo registries and chart repositories need separate provider and retrieval assessments.
gaps.nextProof: Select one concrete protocol and qualify native coordinates, authentication, retrieval, conflict and retry behavior before offering runnable commands.

gaps.title: Assess static assets and release binaries
gaps.currentGap: Release-binary and object/static distribution mechanisms have independent requirements; a generic upload is not their qualification.
gaps.nextProof: Select a protocol and scoped test target, retrieve exact payload/evidence and verify its native consumption.

gaps.title: Observe Kubernetes readiness and rollback
gaps.currentGap: The public deployment-kind contract is draft and is not implemented by a kind SDK or oyzu kind command. A chart build is not an observed deployment.
gaps.nextProof: Select a real public integration or explicit external-tool task, deploy an immutable artifact, observe readiness, update and roll back with cleanup.

gaps.title: Activate a service on a disposable machine
gaps.currentGap: No machine/service provider has been selected or qualified for this collection.
gaps.nextProof: Deliver one immutable package to an authorized machine, activate it, observe health and document rollback/cleanup.

gaps.title: Assess cloud application and serverless targets
gaps.currentGap: No cloud provider or account scope is selected; desired-state submission alone is not a deployment proof.
gaps.nextProof: Choose one public provider integration with scoped credentials and observe the destination serving the selected artifact.

gaps.title: Preview and apply infrastructure explicitly
gaps.currentGap: Invoking an external infrastructure tool through tasks does not establish a native graph or policy-authority integration.
gaps.nextProof: Use a disposable scoped target, review a native preview, apply only the authorized change and inspect actual outputs/cleanup.

gaps.title: Promote the same artifact across environments
gaps.currentGap: Environment names grant no authority and the collection has no qualified promotion provider.
gaps.nextProof: Promote one existing immutable artifact through selected environments without rebuilding, checking authority and observed destination identity.

gaps.title: Use Oyzu from CI without private source
gaps.currentGap: Public example execution needs an approved downloadable CLI and checksum until a public engine release exists.
gaps.nextProof: Configure a public approved binary, verify its checksum, run affected recipes on PRs and retain exact non-secret records.

gaps.title: Assess Make
gaps.currentGap: This collection has no qualified native Make integration. A generic task invocation is not native graph, acquisition, artifact or evidence support.
gaps.nextProof: Select a concrete native project and ownership contract, then prove its real build, dependency capture, delivered artifact and consumer before adding a runnable recipe.
